title: Decomposition of Spillover Effects Under Misspecification: Pseudo-true Estimands and a Local-Global Extension
abstract: arXiv:2602.12023v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: To measure spillovers, researchers often summarize who else was treated with a simple measure, such as the share of treated neighbors. We study what the researcher estimates when that summary is misspecified. We show that the researcher estimates the best approximation to the true policy effect among all functionals of the chosen summary, and that the usual direct and spillover estimates are exactly the components of this approximation. We then specialize this framework to a setting common in applications such as cash transfers: treatment spills over both globally, through market equilibrium, and locally, through network externalities, while the researcher models only one channel. The network estimator still recovers the network spillover, and the equilibrium estimator the equilibrium spillover, even when the other channel is ignored. We illustrate with a simulation calibrated to a large cash-transfer experiment.

translated_title: 误设情形下溢出效应的分解：伪真实估计量与局部-全局扩展
translated_abstract: 为了度量溢出效应，研究者通常用一个简单的度量来概括其他人是否受到处理，例如邻居中受处理者的比例。我们研究当这一概括度量存在误设时，研究者实际估计的是什么。我们证明，研究者估计的是在所选概括度量的所有泛函中对真实政策效应的最佳逼近，而通常的直接效应与溢出效应估计恰好构成这一逼近的组成部分。随后，我们将该框架应用于现金转移等应用中常见的情形：处理效应既通过市场均衡产生全局溢出，又通过网络外部性产生局部溢出，而研究者只对其中一个渠道进行建模。结果表明，即使忽略另一个渠道，网络估计量仍能恢复网络溢出效应，均衡估计量仍能恢复均衡溢出效应。我们通过与一项大型现金转移实验校准的模拟来展示这些结果。
tldr: 该论文证明当溢出效应的概括度量存在误设时，研究者估计的是真实政策效应的最佳逼近，并进一步表明即使只对局部网络或全局均衡其中一个溢出渠道建模，对应估计量仍能准确恢复该渠道的溢出效应。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that under a misspecified summary measure of spillovers, the researcher estimates the best approximation to the true policy effect, and demonstrates that even when only one spillover channel—local network or global equilibrium—is modeled, the corresponding estimator still recovers that channel's spillover effect.
